The '''Perlemian node''' was a location in the [[Tynna sector/Legends|Tynna sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] that was intersected by the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]]. It was located near [[Kelarea]]. The [[Perlemian Traffic Control]] operated at this location. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Omega Squad]] conducted a [[Traffic Interdiction Operations|TIOPS]] [[Mission to the Corellian-Perlemian Intersection|mission]] at the Corellian&ndash;Perlemian [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] intersection.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Perlemian node first appeared in the [[2006]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]]. It was later mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]'', which was also written by Karen Traviss.

It is unclear whether the Perlemian node is an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] or an astronomical object. Despite its name however, the Perlemian node is not related to the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which intersects the Corellian Run at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
